arguments.value: The customer needs help deleting an image file from the Laravel storage directory when deleting a record. The database record is removed successfully, but the physical file remains in the folder. They shared a destroy() method where the image path appears to be handled incorrectly, since printing $datos shows the whole model/JSON instead of just the file path.
